blocks.x: Connected machines to connected margin — service revenue attach up 3x
A construction-equipment manufacturer — Manufacturing & Industrial engagement delivered by a 22-person team over 18 months, Global scope, commercial model: build-run.

items: Installed base unconnected; service reactive; contract pricing on tradition.
Warranty leakage unexplained; failure knowledge anecdotal.
EU CRA product-security duties landing on unmanaged firmware estates.

blocks.x: The machine fleet platform brought provisioning, OTA and telemetry to the installed base; service economics (cost per machine, contract profitability) were instrumented on Forge; dispatch orchestration lifted first-time-fix; and the product-security program (SBOM, signed firmware, vulnerability SLAs) turned CRA duties into evidence.
A construction-equipment manufacturer uses the standard Achala delivery pattern — nothing bespoke about the governance, everything bespoke about the design. That split is deliberate.

items: The measured delta and the method note are written up on the case page — anonymized by agreement, baseline audited.
Written up as a case study: the baseline, the measured outcome and the method, with client identity withheld by agreement.

blocks.x: Towers: IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System, KYC Management System.
